note: AI agent catalog. Tasks are assigned to agents in ai/<DISC>.json. readiness: 3 ready now (reads documents and exports only), 2 needs a prerequisite (tag crosswalk, class library, read access to a tool database), 1 needs write access into engineering or commercial systems. Assumptions to confirm with IT and the discipline leads.

patterns.extract: Read documents or drawings and turn them into structured data
patterns.draft: Write a first draft of a document or dataset from structured inputs
patterns.check: Compare two or more sources and flag what disagrees
patterns.review: Check a submitted document against its requirements and draft comments
patterns.transfer: Carry data from one system to another, with a person approving the load
patterns.monitor: Watch status, dates and quantities; chase, warn and report
patterns.record: Capture meetings and decisions; track actions to close-out
patterns.answer: Answer questions from the project record, with citations

autonomy.1: Assist: the agent suggests; the person does the work
autonomy.2: Draft: the agent produces; a named person checks, edits and issues
autonomy.3: Act with audit: the agent acts within set rules; a person reviews exceptions and samples

agents.name: Drawing and P&ID reader
agents.what: Reads P&IDs, PFDs, plot plans and vendor or licensor drawings (PDF or scan) and lists the tags, lines, connections, notes and holds they contain.
agents.human: The owning engineer accepts or corrects each extracted tag before it is loaded anywhere.
agents.guardrails: Never writes into SPID, SI or S3D; every value carries its drawing number, revision and location on the sheet.
agents.readiness_note: Works on issued PDFs today; no tool access needed.

agents.name: Vendor document reviewer
agents.what: Checks vendor drawings, data and calculations against the datasheet, requisition and specifications; drafts review comments and pulls certified values (weights, loads, nozzles, motor data) into registers.
agents.human: The responsible engineer sets the review code and signs the comments.
agents.guardrails: Comments cite the clause they rely on; it never returns a review code to a vendor itself.
agents.readiness_note: Reads documents only.

agents.name: Cross-system consistency checker
agents.what: Before each issue, compares the same tag or line across SPID, SI, S3D, SPEL, the line list and the equipment register, and lists every mismatch with both values.
agents.human: Each discipline lead clears their mismatches; the agent re-checks.
agents.guardrails: Read-only on every tool; reports, never fixes.
agents.readiness_note: Needs read access to the tool databases or scheduled exports.

agents.name: Datasheet drafter
agents.what: Fills process, mechanical, instrument and electrical datasheets from HYSYS cases, SI, the line list and the equipment register, and marks what changed since the last revision.
agents.human: The engineer checks every datasheet and issues it under their name.
agents.guardrails: Values it could not source are left blank and flagged, never assumed.
agents.readiness_note: Needs HYSYS stream export and datasheet templates.

agents.name: Requisition and bid evaluation assistant
agents.what: Assembles requisition packages from datasheets and specs, compares vendor technical bids clause by clause, drafts TBE tables, clarifications and deviation lists.
agents.human: The engineer recommends; Procurement awards.
agents.guardrails: No commercial data in technical evaluations; never ranks bidders on its own.
agents.readiness_note: Documents only.

agents.name: Specification and standards assistant
agents.what: Answers questions on project specs, owner standards, codes and the design basis with citations, and checks drafts against them for deviations.
agents.human: The engineer decides; the agent only points to the clause.
agents.guardrails: Answers only from the indexed project record and cites document, revision and clause.
agents.readiness_note: Needs an index of the spec library only.

agents.name: Design basis and calculation input checker
agents.what: Holds the current design basis values (site data, criteria, cases), feeds them into calculations and flags calculations built on a superseded basis revision.
agents.human: The calc originator and checker accept the inputs.
agents.guardrails: Basis values change only through the owning discipline.
agents.readiness_note: Documents and workbooks only.

agents.name: Safety study scribe and action tracker
agents.what: Drafts HAZOP, HAZID and LOPA worksheets from the session record, tracks every recommendation to close-out and checks that the close-out evidence exists.
agents.human: The study leader and team own every entry; actions close only on the owner's sign-off.
agents.guardrails: Never closes a safety action; never changes a risk ranking.
agents.readiness_note: Works on session notes and the PHA export.

agents.name: Safety instrumented logic drafter
agents.what: Drafts cause-and-effect charts, the SIF list and SRS tables from the trip schedule, LOPA and SI, and checks them against the P&IDs and the DCS/SIS configuration.
agents.human: The I&C and process safety engineers check and approve every line.
agents.guardrails: Safety-critical: always draft only, with independent human verification.
agents.readiness_note: Needs SI and PHA exports keyed by tag.

agents.name: Expediting agent
agents.what: Chases vendors for document returns and manufacturing progress, updates the purchasing database and warns when a forecast passes the P6 need date.
agents.human: The expeditor handles escalations and anything commercial.
agents.guardrails: Sends only templated status requests; no commitments or commercial terms.
agents.readiness_note: Needs write access to status fields in the purchasing database and an email account.

agents.name: Document control agent
agents.what: Checks transmittals, numbering, title blocks and revision status, keeps the deliverables register in step with P6 and Document Locator, and lists overdue reviews.
agents.human: Document control approves register changes.
agents.guardrails: Never issues or supersedes a document.
agents.readiness_note: Document Locator metadata and P6 exports.

agents.name: Progress and schedule analyst
agents.what: Compiles progress from document status, quantities and installed counts, drafts the period report narrative and flags critical-path and need-date risks.
agents.human: Project controls validates and issues.
agents.guardrails: Shows the source of every figure.
agents.readiness_note: Exports only.

agents.name: Estimate and quantity assistant
agents.what: Builds quantity takeoffs from the register, model reports and benchmarks, and checks estimate quantities against the latest MTOs.
agents.human: The estimator owns the estimate.
agents.guardrails: Flags every factor or benchmark it applied.
agents.readiness_note: Model reports and workbooks.

agents.name: Material reconciliation agent
agents.what: Reconciles MTO, purchased, shipped, received and issued quantities by ident and CWP; forecasts shortages and surplus.
agents.human: Materials manager acts on shortages; buyers place orders.
agents.guardrails: Never orders material.
agents.readiness_note: Needs the ident map between MTO, purchasing and Jovix.
agents.prerequisite: Commodity code to purchasing ident map

agents.name: Work package builder
agents.what: Assembles CWP and IWP content (drawings, isos, materials, holds, permits), checks constraints are cleared and lists what blocks release.
agents.human: The work packager and superintendent release the package.
agents.guardrails: Cannot release a package with an open constraint.
agents.readiness_note: Needs CWA/CWP codes on model objects.

agents.name: RFI, query and field change assistant
agents.what: Answers RFIs and technical queries from the project record where the answer already exists, drafts responses for the engineer, routes changes to the owning discipline and tracks as-built redlines to closure.
agents.human: The responsible engineer signs every response that changes design.
agents.guardrails: Design changes always go to a person; cites the documents it relied on.
agents.readiness_note: Procore and Document Locator read access.

agents.name: Completions assistant
agents.what: Builds system and subsystem tag registers, assigns ITRs by tag class, checks test packs and turnover dossiers for completeness and drafts punch summaries.
agents.human: Completions engineers accept registers; turnover is signed by people.
agents.guardrails: Never signs an ITR or accepts a system.
agents.readiness_note: Needs tag-to-system codes.
agents.prerequisite: Tag crosswalk; system codes on tags

agents.name: Coordination and interface manager
agents.what: Records coordination meetings, model reviews and interface queries; tracks actions and inter-discipline holds; reminds owners before need dates.
agents.human: Chairs approve minutes; owners close their actions.
agents.guardrails: Records decisions, never makes them.
agents.readiness_note: Meeting notes and transcripts only.

agents.name: Change impact tracer
agents.what: When an item is revised, uses this register's exchanges to list every task, document and system downstream that relies on it, at the level it needs, and tells their owners.
agents.human: Each notified owner decides whether to revise.
agents.guardrails: Notifies; never revises.
agents.readiness_note: Runs on this register plus Document Locator revision events.

agents.name: Model and drawing checker
agents.what: Checks model reports, isometrics and steel drawings against the line list, piping specs, standards and clash rules before review and issue.
agents.human: The designer and checker clear findings; the checker still signs.
agents.guardrails: Read-only on models.
agents.readiness_note: Needs scheduled model reports.
